description: Returns the 2026 or 2027 elective-deferral limit for a 401(k), 403(b), governmental 457(b), the TSP or a SIMPLE IRA at an age (the age-50 and ages 60-63 catch-ups, the SIMPLE higher limit, the Roth catch-up wage rule), free; and what the pre-tax deferral saves in federal income tax (with the 2026 Saver's Credit) and state income tax, with $0 Social Security and Medicare tax saved and no state saving in Pennsylvania (and New Jersey for all but the 401(k)): the same return with and without the deferral. The limits are the website's contribution-limit pages' own figures (the 2027 limits are projections under the statutory indexing formula until the IRS publishes its 2027 limits notice, labelled as such; the 2027 tax is on the IRS's published 2027 brackets); the tax figures come from QuantCalc's federal and state tax APIs and need a connected QuantCalc PRO licence or Tax Season Pass. Not tax advice.

age.description: Your age on December 31 of the tax year (18-110): sets the catch-up (50+, and the higher catch-up in the years you turn 60 to 63).

amount.description: The pre-tax deferral for the year. Default: your full limit at your age. Over the limit or over your wages it is figured on the lower.

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, married filing jointly (mfj), married filing separately (mfs) or head of household (hoh).

higher_limit_simple.description: simple only: the employer uses the SECURE 2.0 higher-limit SIMPLE.

non_governmental_457.description: 457b only: a tax-exempt (non-governmental) employer's 457(b), which has no catch-up.

plan.description: The workplace plan: 401(k), 403(b), governmental 457(b), the TSP, or a SIMPLE IRA.

roth_catchup.description: Not for simple: true when your prior-year Social Security wages from this employer were over the year's threshold, so the catch-up must go in as Roth (no tax saved now). Default: whether wages are over the threshold, stated in the result.

spouse_age.description: Joint return only: the spouse's age. Default: the same as age.

spouse_wages.description: Joint return only: the spouse's own wages. Default 0.

state.description: Optional two-letter state of residence, or DC: adds the state tax saving (licence needed). Without it no state saving is figured.

tax_year.description: 2026 (default) or 2027. 2027: the limits and phase-out ranges are the 2027 pages' PROJECTIONS under each limit's statutory indexing formula (the IRS's 2027 retirement-plan limits notice is not out yet), labelled as such; the tax on the IRS's published 2027 amounts (Rev. Proc. 2026-35); the state line on each state's 2026 rules, labelled. Stated in the result.

wages.description: Your wages before the contribution (more than 0): the deferral comes out of them.

name: retirement_plan_deferral_savings
title: 401(k), 403(b), 457(b), TSP or SIMPLE IRA limit and the tax a deferral saves (2026; 2027 limits projected)
